description: The dataset includes two ZIP files of sensor input and output, identified by the Binary column. Both have MIME type “application/zip” and sizes from 246.9 kBytes to 446.5 MBytes. Each record shows event “UPC”, latitude 41.393°, longitude 2.12°, elevation 115 m, date 2020‑03‑11, with latitude ranging 0–41.393 and longitude 0–2.12; the Binary fields act as identifiers, geographic columns give location and elevation, and Date/Time provides a daily timestamp. These geospatial sensor records can support mapping of retail events, sensor coverage analysis, or integration with other spatial data for environmental or logistical studies.
